crossRefs.note: The thin and ugly cattle ate up the first seven fat cattle;

translations.web: The thin and ugly cattle ate up the first seven fat cattle;
translations.bsb: Then the thin, ugly cows devoured the seven well-fed cows that were there first.
translations.kjv: And the lean and the ill favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine:
translations.asv: and the lean and ill-favored kine did eat up the first seven fat kine:
